name: Sitemate
description:
Sitemate connects Claude directly to your Dashpivot data, so your team can ask questions and pull field records without leaving the chat.

Dashpivot is the field reporting and compliance platform for the built world — safety, quality, environmental, commercial, and asset records captured on site via the web and the Sitemate mobile app. The Sitemate MCP server gives Claude structured, authenticated, read access to that data, always scoped to the permissions of the connecting user. You never see or do more than you can inside Dashpivot itself.

Use it to:
• Summarise incident reports, ITPs, defect reports, and inspections
• Track NCRs, permits, and open actions across projects
• Rank subcontractor risk and surface compliance gaps
• Query registers, lists, and analytics in natural language
• Pull the right record ahead of a meeting without scrolling through folders

Your data stays structured, permissioned, and scoped to your workspace — your data, your control. Sitemate is SOC 2 certified and GDPR compliant, with encryption in transit and at rest.

Requirements: a Dashpivot account and a Claude plan that supports custom connectors. Connect once with your Sitemate login and your existing permissions apply automatically.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sitemate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sitemate to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.sitemate.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sitemate MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sitemate provides these MCP tools: get-apps, get-forms, get-lists, get-users, get-workspace-structure, and suggest.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sitemate?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sitemate in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Sitemate requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sitemate is developed by Sitemate. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
